import java.util.*;
public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Edge {
        int v, p, c, w;

        Edge(int v, int p, int c, int w) {
            this.v = v;
            this.p = p;
            this.c = c;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        static final int N = 10001;
        List<Edge>[] g = new ArrayList[N];
        int[] vis = new int[N], cur = new int[N], n;
        int[] dis = new int[N], pot = new int[N];

        MCMF() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int addv(int c) {
            int start = n[0];
            for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
                g[n[0]++] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            return start;
        }

        void adde(int u, int v, int c, int w) {
            g[u].add(new Edge(v, g[v].size(), c, w));
            g[v].add(new Edge(u, g[u].size() - 1, 0, -w));
        }

        boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dis, 0, n[0], INF);
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n[0], 0);
            PriorityQueue<int[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            dis[s] = 0;
            q.offer(new int[]{dis[s], s});
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int[] top = q.poll();
                int u = top[1], du = top[0];
                if (vis[u] != 0) continue;
                vis[u] = 1;
                for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    int dv = du + pot[u] + e.w - pot[v];
                    if (e.c == 0 || vis[v] != 0 || dis[v] <= dv) continue;
                    dis[v] = dv;
                    q.offer(new int[]{dis[v], v});
                }
            }
            return vis[t] != 0;
        }

        boolean dinic_bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n[0], 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            vis[s] = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    if (vis[v] != 0 || e.c == 0) continue;
                    if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
                    vis[v] = vis[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
            return vis[t] != 0;
        }

        int dinic_dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
            if (u == t) return f;
            int sf = 0;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i < g[u].size(); ++i, cur[u] = i) {
                Edge e = g[u].get(i);
                int v = e.v;
                if (e.c == 0 || vis[v] != vis[u] + 1) continue;
                if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;
                int df = dinic_dfs(v, t, Math.min(e.c, f));
                if (df > 0) {
                    e.c -= df;
                    g[v].get(e.p).c += df;
                    sf += df;
                    f -= df;
                    if (f == 0) break;
                }
            }
            return sf;
        }

        int[] mincostflow(int s, int t, int mf) {
            int sf = 0, sc = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n[0], 0);
            while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
                int f = 0;
                while (dinic_bfs(s, t)) {
                    Arrays.fill(cur, 0, n[0], 0);
                    int df = dinic_dfs(s, t, mf);
                    if (df == 0) break;
                    mf -= df;
                    f += df;
                }
                sf += f;
                sc += (dis[t] + pot[t]) * f;
                for (int i = 0; i < n[0]; i++) pot[i] += dis[i];
                if (mf == 0) break;
            }
            return new int[]{sf, sc};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n_ = sc.nextInt();
        int m_ = sc.nextInt();
        int k_ = sc.nextInt();
        int c_ = sc.nextInt();
        int d_ = sc.nextInt();

        int l = Math.max(n_, k_) * 2;
        MCMF mcmf = new MCMF();
        mcmf.n = new int[]{0};

        int s = mcmf.addv(1);
        int t = mcmf.addv(1);
        for (int j = 0; j < k_; j++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcmf.adde(s, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 1; z <= m_; z++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < l; i++) {
                int u1 = u + i * n_;
                int v1 = v + (i + 1) * n_;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n_;
                int v2 = v + i * n_;
                for (int j = 0; j < k_; j++) {
                    mcmf.adde(u1, v1, 1, c_ + d_ * (2 * j + 1));
                    mcmf.adde(v2, u2, 1, c_ + d_ * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < l; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n_; j++) {
                int u = j + i * n_;
                int v = j + (i + 1) * n_;
                mcmf.adde(u, v, INF, c_);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < l; i++) {
            int u = i * n_;
            mcmf.adde(u, t, INF, 0);
        }
        int[] result = mcmf.mincostflow(s, t, INF);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
